reason: Internal: design bundle only, no code. Completes Step 0 of design/evaluation/ — all seven eval-side subjects now compared against production construction of the same component. Four reach the model: RelevanceGate (the sender name and the media description, 539 vs 559 bytes), FirePath (three prompt blocks empty or absent from three integers defaulting to zero, with the people_in_window block not rendered at all), RegistryToolSource (online_scope_for and origin_rooms change what the tools answer, which is what the model reads next) and build_offline_pipeline (seven of twenty-one collaborators unpassed, one of them deliberately). Three come back empty and are not defects: both DreamerRuntimes, because the note-candidates adaptor declares no tools so grants and tool budget overrides are no-ops and production gives it no grant either, and because store_timeout_seconds default is 15.0 which is the configured value; and LiveAgentRunner, whose missing argument is a metric sink. The empty results are the most useful part: which four mattered could not be known in advance — the DreamerRuntime difference looks alarming and is inert, store_timeout_seconds looks inert and had to be checked against a constant, and media_join turns out load-bearing in three of the four subjects. The finding is therefore not that the eval layer is broken but that seven assemblies exist, four of them measure something the deployment does not send, three do not, and nothing in the tree distinguishes them.
